group: get method with null key and size conditions

cases.description: Test case when key is null and size is 1. The method should return value1 as key1 is also null.
Test case when key is null and size is 2. The method should return value2 if key2 is null.

Test case when key is non-null and size is 2, and key2 matches key. The method should return value2.

Test case when key is null and size is 3. The method should return value3 if key3 is null.
Test case when key is null and size is 2. The method should return value2 if key2 is null.
Test case when key is null and size is 1. The method should return value1 if key1 is null.
